title: OpenULF: A Modular Toolkit Enables Data-Driven Ultra-Low-Field MRI with both Classical and Quantum Sensors
summary: In one SQUID simulation at 50 µT, a UNet using four averages reached approximately the same PSNR as SimpleCNN using twenty. The separate modeled SQUID–coil crossover was mainly a sensor-physics effect. Model and acquisition trade-offs were explored over four anatomical datasets using a simulator checked against analytical physics tests. The illustrative time reduction is simulated and no hardware or clinical test is claimed.
ai_technology: Trained reconstruction networks were used across simulated ultra-low-field MRI sensor, field and acquisition settings.
